left.title: Republicans gush over Klobuchar
left.body: GOP senators praised the Minnesota Democrat for her deal-cutting ways — even as they worried it could doom her presidential bid.
left.roundup: Senator Amy Klobuchar (D-MN) enters the 2020 Presidential race as a moderate in an increasingly crowded field.

center.title: Senator Klobuchar joins Democratic presidential field
center.body: Senator Amy Klobuchar entered the 2020 presidential race on Sunday, becoming the first moderate in an increasingly crowded field of Democrats vying to challenge Republican President Donald Trump.
center.roundup: Senator Amy Klobuchar (D-MN) enters the 2020 Presidential race as a moderate in an increasingly crowded field.

right.title: Scandal-Plagued Sen. Amy Klobuchar Announces 2020 Presidential Run
right.body: "Minnesota Nice" branding belies mean streak and temper, said staff. Will it harm her presidential chances?
right.roundup: Senator Amy Klobuchar (D-MN) enters the 2020 Presidential race as a moderate in an increasingly crowded field.
